titulo: Describing: adjectives, colors, clothes and shopping: Describing people and clothes

aula.titulo: Describing: adjectives, colors, clothes and shopping
aula.objetivo: Describe people and things with adjectives in the right position, talk about colors and clothes, and shop with prices and numbers above 100.

blocos.titulo: Saying what someone is like and what they wear
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: to describe the body, French uses «avoir» + definite article: «Elle a les yeux bleus.» «Il a les cheveux courts.» «Elle a les cheveux longs et noirs.» STEP 2: for height and build, use «être»: «Il est grand.» «Elle est mince.» STEP 3: for what someone wears, use «porter»: «Il porte un pantalon noir.» «Elle porte une robe verte.» STEP 4: the present of «porter» is regular: «je porte, tu portes, il porte, nous portons, vous portez, ils portent». STEP 5: to say how clothes look on someone: «Cette robe te va bien.» (that dress suits you). STEP 6: description sequence: «Elle est grande et mince. Elle a les cheveux longs et noirs. Elle porte un pantalon bleu et une chemise blanche.»
blocos.comparacao: in English we say «she has blue eyes»; French says «elle a les yeux bleus», with the definite «les». Physical description uses «avoir» and «être» in different contexts.

tabela.structure: avoir + les yeux / les cheveux + adj

erros.motivo: Body parts take the definite article.
The color agrees in the plural.

blocos.enunciado: Describe three people out loud (height, hair, eyes, clothes), with «être», «avoir» and «porter».
Say «a beautiful house», «a red car», «a good friend» and «a small table» in French.
